recipes.name: Caramel Popcorn with Marshmallow
ingredients_raw: 0.25 cup light corn syrup (such as Karo®)

steps.text: Stir marshmallows, brown sugar, butter, corn syrup, and vanilla extract together in a large pot over medium-low heat until marshmallows melt, 5 to 7 minutes.
Place popcorn in a large bowl; pour marshmallow mixture over popcorn and gently stir to coat.

raw_recipe.headline: Caramel Popcorn with Marshmallow
raw_recipe.description: This marshmallow caramel popcorn recipe combines three classic treats into one sweet treat using only six ingredients you likely have in your pantry.

review.reviewBody: I believe this to be the actual version of a dumbed down recipe circulating on Pinterest - exact same picture, at least. I've never made caramel corn before - it always seemed like a very involved process. This was really simple, though. Yes, it takes a little time to get it all together (the melting time) but it was totally worth it. My daughters shook some sprinkles in while I was mixing and that was fun. We made the popcorn in our microwave popping bowl and only did half the amount - saving the rest of the caramel for another time. I'll be interested to see how well it melts down next time. Don't hesitate to make this - it's really yummy. Oh, and we only have mini marshmallows. I found somewhere online where it said 1 lg marshmallow=10 minis ... meaning 230 for this recipe. My husband counted them out and it worked great!

Fast, easy, and delicious! Only change I made was using air-popped popcorn instead of microwave. I used 1/2 cup of unpopped kernels and had quite a lot of extra caramel, next time I will probably do 3/4 cup instead. I will definitely make this again, we made popcorn balls and they've stayed soft and delicious for a few days now.

I love the flavor of the Carmel! What I did though, because it reminded me of the popcorn balls I made with my dad as a child, I rubbed butter on my hands and allowed the mixture to cool just until workable , then compressed the popcorn into balls and wrapped them in plastic wrap! Tada!??

Perfect! I wanted something gooey and delicious. This was it, and so fast too! Just double the amount of popcorn or make half the caramel. Otherwise your popcorn is SWIMMING in caramel. I also salted my popcorn (not microwave). 1/2 cup un-popped corn to 1/2 the caramel was just right. You can shape these into balls, too.

This is such a simple and easy recipe. I am only 13 and I made this so many times for the family. I agree with Lae. There is a lot of caramel. What I do to make it more enjoyable, is use 3 bags of popcorn instead of two. Also, I take the kernals out of the popcorn before adding caramel for a more enjoyable time when eating it. It tastes chewy, sweet, and delightlful. A perfect recipe for caramel popcorn;)

It is addictive! I did change a couple of things...I popped the popcorn in a pan vs. microwave popcorn. I added a little salt to the caramel, cut the brown sugar in half and added chocolate m-n-m's. This was for a baby shower and I put it in a bowl with a sign that said "She's about to pop".

Extremely easy and Extremely yummy! I did double up on the amount of popcorn listed. I also put the finished popcorn in a warm oven for about 40 minutes and stirred it every 10 minutes. This helped it stick to the popcorn and not be so sticky for the kids. Yes, I have the kids that would eat it either way and then run off to play with sticky hands. lol
Fast, Easy and yummy!!! We added a sprinkling of salt, and then tossed in a cup of chocolate chips and mixed it all together. SO GOOD!

This was so delicious and easy to make. It makes a ton of the caramel topping I actually had enough for at least 3 bags of popcorn. I saved some and a few days later slowly heated up in the microwave and it tasted just as wonderful and it was a quick treat that day for my family. I also added chocolate chips to one batch and a little extra salt and it was simply divine ;)
It is worth the time to make it! Make sure to not have the heat too high, I imagine that this would burn easily.
Completely, totally amazing caramel popcorn! I ended up adding some cinnamon to the caramel before putting it on the popcorn and also salting the popcorn after I put the caramel on. Sooooo good!
A little on the sweet side. Were I to make it again, I would cut the sugar by half and leave out the corn syrup. I would also make sure I keep the heat low.
Me and my family loved it! I was so happy to make this, make it NOW!
This was so easy to make and was delicious. Ooey gooey and yummy.
Yummy
Easy to make we just drizzled it over the popcorn family liked it

This was a nice change, but two main problems - far too sweet (I think the combo of all that brown sugar and marshmallows did that), and my popcorn lost all its crunch from the warm caramel. While we all ate it, I probably won’t make this again.
Made as written, most excellent, best we have ever made made. If you dont like sticky fingers skip this recipe, but know you are cheating yourself! Thanks for the recipe
So easy, so delicious and sticky chewey can't get enough of it. Addictive.
Delicious! Perfect recipe.
So easy and so yummy!
